chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen's Flesh Rebirth and Defeat of the Yasha King
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen returns in the flesh to confront the Yasha King, using the World Gates of the Eight Aspect Worlds to break his Void Transgression and rout the invincible king. A turning point in the Hundred Races era.
og_title: Xiao Chen's Flesh Rebirth – Defeating the Yasha King
og_description: After years in the death world, Xiao Chen resurrects and crushes the Yasha King with the Eight Aspect World Gates, marking his triumphant return.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen Returns to Defeat the Yasha King
twitter_description: Xiao Chen defeats the Yasha King using the World Gates of the Eight Aspect Worlds—a major victory in the Hundred Races conflict.
